_description: Manual ETCDR ground truth. After the canonicalisation pre-step (apply entity_resolution.json + relationship_resolution.json), the harness iterates the resulting relationships in the order they appear in test-extracted/relationships.json, feeding each one to detect_and_resolve() with the previously accepted edges as the intra-batch context. For each expected resolution, list the (source, relation_type, target) triple of the candidate (using the CANONICAL strings, post-merge) and the strategy ETCDR should choose. Identical triples that appear more than once in the batch are matched against entries here in order — the first occurrence matches the first matching entry, the second occurrence matches the second matching entry, etc. Candidates whose triple does not appear in `expected` are skipped during scoring. Available strategies: NEW_EDGE, CORROBORATION, EVOLUTION, CORRECTION, DISAGREEMENT. The optional `cardinality` field lets you pin the relation's cardinality so the harness does not call the LLM classifier for it (one of SUBJECT_EXCLUSIVE, OBJECT_EXCLUSIVE, BOTH_EXCLUSIVE, NON_EXCLUSIVE).
